name: codex-pulse
description: Monitor Codex usage, live rate limits, and /status-style session information in the terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor Codex usage and live limits in the terminal.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight terminal pulse for Codex usage. It reads live rate limits through Codex app-server, session token_count events, and local session metadata to print a /status-style view or compact status line.
defaultPrompt: Start a live Codex Pulse monitor.
Print a compact Codex Pulse statusline.
